dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Aren't you meant to be taking a break? No need to fuss over me... I'll just have a look around myself.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: If you really want to do something for me... why don't you tell me about that device over there? It looks... vaguely interesting, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: "A Mysterious Device That Can Play Music"...? Hah. Who came up with that awful name?
